examples:
Feature: Notes
  Rule: R-1
    @R-1 @E-1
    Scenario: Create a note
      When the user posts a note
      Then the note is stored

  Rule: R-2
    @R-2 @E-2
    Scenario: List notes
      When the user lists notes
      Then the notes are returned
contract:
openapi: 3.1.0
info: {title: notes, version: '1'}
paths:
  /notes:
    post:
      operationId: createNote
      x-rules: [R-1]
      responses: {'201': {description: created}}
    get:
      operationId: listNotes
      x-rules: [R-2]
      responses: {'200': {description: ok}}
